FAQ

Q: Do I need experience to join?
A: Not at all! We welcome all skill levels.

Q: What should I bring?
A: Just wear comfortable sports clothes — we’ll provide the rest!

Q: Is this club beginner-friendly?
A: Absolutely! We have starter classes and a welcoming community for everyone.

Q: When and where do we meet?
A: Practices are every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday at Sheridan Trafalgar Campus Gym.
